reviews.text:
#Mapo #Dohwa-dong #Jeongdaepo

Mapo has long had many delicious pork restaurants.

Synonym for grilled salt 
Pork rib restaurant 
strongman of tradition 
And I finally found it 

Galmaegisal, which is the same part as the inside of beef, is the muscle that moves the diaphragm, so it has a lot of exercise, so it has a chewy texture and is also very juicy, so it is considered the best special part for meat lovers. Ironically, beef shank meat is recognized as a high-quality cut, but galmaegisal meat is not a high-quality special cut because it becomes very tough if cooked incorrectly.

The Choi Dae-po restaurant I tried this time said, "You leave it to yourself"... hehe.

#mood
Like most pork restaurants in Mapo, the setting where you can sit around a drum table and eat is cozy. The friendly-looking aunt showed me to my seat with a smile, which put me in a good mood right from the start of the meal. It is a place full of old atmosphere and sensibility.

#galmaegisal
The freshly sliced chunks of meat are delicious. Once the round grill is sufficiently heated, place a few pieces of seagull meat on it.
The sound of meat being grilled with a 'chi~~~ik' sound stimulates the appetite.
If you take a piece of well-grilled galmaegal meat in your mouth and chew it...
 The feeling makes your teeth vibrate.
It may feel a little tough, but the muscle fibers that resist begin to cut refreshingly and cheerfully.
The lightly seasoned taste between the finely broken pieces of meat adds a colorful touch to the monotony of the meat.
“It’s really delicious~~~~”

#grilled eggs
The grill here has round grooves around it, so pour egg water into them.
If you add finely chopped kimchi and green onion slices to egg water and bake them, you get a really delicious grilled egg.
Unlike seasoned meat, the grilled egg is light and has the rich taste of kimchi, which is also amazing.

#Yeolradish noodles
The broth is very sweet and not my taste.

I've tried quite a few galmaegisal (chicken ribs), but this restaurant's texture was the best.
It's an old, long-established store... I'm almost blaming myself as to why I only found out about it now.

• Proper fire scent!!
• If you talk twice, you will nag.

A perfect combination with a spicy main dish!

The price may feel a little high, but considering the quality of ingredients and taste, it is completely acceptable.

reviews.author: Heee
reviews.text:
There was no one there so I went in right away and my boyfriend went there because it was a place he often visits near his house, but I was shocked by the attitude of the part-time worker.
Last time, the meat seemed a bit salty, so I politely asked if they could add a little less salt, but he said in an aggressive tone, "I guess you're eating it too bland? How bland do I have to make it for you?" He said this. I was embarrassed, but I tried to move on by saying that he would just lessen the salt, but he continued to argue until the end, adding, “I guess you’re very sensitive,” so I couldn’t believe my ears.
Isn't it the employee's job to make it bland when he or she asks for it, rather than blindly criticizing the customer for being "sensitive"? It's not a rude or unreasonable request.
I tend to just leave reviews of good places and never go back to bad places, but I hope you don't end up ruining your mood like we did when you went for a meal on a nice day.
